Name: Dinosaur Eggs are Animal Products
Author: literaltree
Description:
[size=3][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Changes the context tag of Dinosaur Eggs from 0 (uncategorised) to -5 (eggs) in order to allow for boosts to animal product sell prices (i.e. rancher profession) to apply to them.[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the contents into your mods folder[/color][/size]

[size=3][b]Source on Codeberg:[/b][/size]
[size=2][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://codeberg.org/literal_tree/StardewValleyMods/src/branch/main/%5BCP%5D%20Dino%20Egg%20Animal%20Products]https://codeberg.org/literal_tree/StardewValleyMods/src/branch/main/[CP] Dino Egg Animal Products[/url][/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Dinosaur Eggs are Animal Products
Manifest.Description: Changes dino eggs to be considered animal products for the purpose of the rancher profession.
